blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Language models often need to maintain multiple contextual variables that evolve independently within a document. Prior work has identified structured representations of individual temporal or contextual quantities, but their joint organization remains less understood. We study this question using controlled documents with independently phased language-switch and topic-change timers. Across ten pretrained checkpoints, both timers are linearly decodable from the same hidden states. Removing a timer-associated centroid plane substantially reduces access to its associated variable while having little effect on the concurrent timer, although the planes are nonorthogonal and contain cross-timer information. Separate timer contributions also explain most reproducible variation among joint-state centroids. These signatures persist from 3 to 51 timer values and across Qwen3 checkpoints from 0.6B to 14B. Schedule position affects continuation probabilities, but the tested centroid displacement produces no consistent timer-specific output effect. Together, these results support approximate factorization based on selective accessibility and approximately additive joint-state geometry in overlapping subspaces.
blocks.zh: 语言模型往往需要保持多个在文档中独立演化的上下文变量. 先前的工作确定了个别时间或背景数量的结构化表述,但对其联合组织的理解仍然较少。 我们利用具有独立相继语言开关和主题变化计时器的控制文件来研究这个问题。 在10个事先经过训练的检查站,两个计时器都线性地可以从同一个隐藏州解码。 移除一个与计时器相关联的百分位平面会大大减少对其相关变量的获取,同时对并发计时器影响不大,尽管平面是非正交的并包含跨计时器信息. 单独的计时器贡献也解释了大多数可再生异构在联合态的百分数中的差异. 这些签名在3至51个计时器值之间以及从0.6B到14B的Quen3检查站之间持续存在。 时刻表位置会影响持续概率,但被测试的百分子迁移不会产生一致的定时器特定输出效果. 这些结果共同支持了基于选择性可获取性和相重叠子空间中大约添加型联态几何的近似入计量.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: A language model processing a document may need to maintain several properties of the context that evolve independently. In dialogue, the speaker may change while the topic remains fixed; in multilingual text, the language may switch independently of the subject matter. At each position, the model must represent the current values of these variables while updating them according to different histories. We study how such concurrent, context-defined variables are jointly organized in pretrained hidden representations.
blocks.zh: 处理文档的语言模型可能需要保持独立演变的上下文的若干属性. 在对话中,发言者可以在专题保持不变的情况下改变;在多语种文本中,语言可以独立于主题事项而转换。 在每个位置,模型必须代表这些变量的当前值,同时根据不同的历史对其进行更新. 我们研究如何在事先经过训练的隐性表述中共同组织这种并行的、上下文界定的变量。

blocks.en: Prior work has identified spatial and temporal coordinates ( Gurnee and Tegmark, 2024 ) , contextual binding vectors ( Feng and Steinhardt, 2024 ) , and a countdown subcircuit ( Dunefsky et al., 2026 ) . These studies establish structured representations of individual temporal or contextual quantities. Much less is known about multiple variables that evolve independently within the same document. Simultaneous linear decodability does not determine whether two variables rely on shared or variable-specific directions, and subspace overlap does not determine whether the information in that overlap is required for decoding.
blocks.zh: 先前的工作确定了空间和时间坐标(Gurnee和Tegmark,2024年),背景约束矢量(Feng和Steinhardt,2024年),以及倒计时的子电路(Dunefsky等人,2026年)。 这些研究确定了个别时间或背景数量的结构化表述。 对同一文件内独立演变的多个变量的了解要少得多。 同时线性可解码性不能确定两个变量是依赖于共享方向还是变量特定方向,子空间重叠不能确定该重叠中的信息是否是解码所需的.

blocks.en: We use controlled documents with independently phased language switches and topic changes. Each variable is represented by the number of sentences since its most recent event. The two schedules produce balanced combinations of timer values while preserving ordinary sentence content. For each timer, we estimate a low-dimensional subspace from its class centroids. We then remove this subspace, retrain the linear decoder, and measure how much timer information remains accessible. Comparing removal of a timer’s own plane with removal of the concurrent timer’s plane provides a direct measure of selectivity.
blocks.zh: 我们使用控制文件,并有独立的分阶段语言开关和主题更改。 每个变量都以自其最近事件以来的句子数量为代表. 这两个附表在保留普通句子内容的同时,产生均衡的计时器值组合. 对于每个计时器, 我们估计一个低维的子空间 从它的类半人马。 然后我们去掉这个子空间,重新训练线性解码器,并测量有多少计时器信息仍然可用. 将去除定时器自己的飞机与去除同时的定时器的飞机相比较,可直接衡量选择性。

blocks.en: Across ten pretrained checkpoints, removing each timer’s centroid plane eliminates substantially more of its associated decoding signal than removing the concurrent timer’s plane. The planes are nonorthogonal and contain information about both timers, while separate timer contributions explain most joint-centroid variation that generalizes across document splits. These results characterize approximate factorization in pretrained representations through selective accessibility and approximately additive joint-state geometry, with overlapping factor-associated subspaces.
blocks.zh: 通过10个事先经过训练的检查站,拆除每架计时器的离心机比拆除同步计时器的飞机更能消除其相关的解码信号。 飞机是非正弦的,包含两个定时器的信息,而单独的定时器贡献则解释了大多数的共中心变异,这些变异在文件的分割中通用. 这些结果的特点是,通过选择性的可获取性和大约添加型联态几何,在预加训练的表示中,有重叠的因子相关空间,形成近似因子化。

blocks.en: We further test generalization across timer horizon and model size. Across 3 to 51 timer values, decoding remains high, effective centroid rank grows slowly, and self-ablation remains much larger than cross-ablation, although cross-ablation increases with horizon. Within Qwen3 from 0.6 0.6 B to 14 14 B, the same signatures persist without a monotonic parameter trend. A recency-matched continuation assay shows that schedule position affects model outputs. Centroid displacements reliably alter decoded timer states, but the tested language-timer displacement from value 1 to value 2 produces no consistent timer-specific change in continuation probabilities across models.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步测试跨时空视野和模型大小的通用化。 在3到51个计时器值上,解码仍然很高,有效的中间行星排名增长缓慢,自我比交叉比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比. 在Qwen3从0.6 B到14 14 B之间,同样的签名持续存在,没有单一参数的趋势. 与计划相符的继续试验表明,时间表位置影响模型产出。 中心迁移可靠地改变了解码计时器状态,但经测试的语言计时器从值1到值2的迁移,在各种模型的延续概率方面,不会产生一致的计时器特定变化。

blocks.en: 2.1 Concurrent event-recency variables
blocks.zh: 2.1 同时发生事件-频率变量

blocks.en: We construct controlled documents with independently phased language switches and topic changes. English and German sentences are drawn from a hand-written bank of parallel propositions on two topics, house and field. No timer labels, event markers, prefixes, or separators are added. Language switches occur every three sentences and topic changes every four, with independent document-level offsets.

The topic analysis retains phases 0 0 – 2 2 from its four-phase schedule. Independent phases and coprime periods yield balanced, independent analyzed labels (Figure 1 A).

The primary corpus contains 100 documents of 48 sentences. Proposition identity is sampled independently within the active topic. Additional analyses use matched stochastic schedules and larger corpora (Appendix A ).

blocks.en: 5.3 Relation to continuation behavior

blocks.en: We next examine the relation between timer representations and the model’s continuation distribution. We first test whether continuation probabilities depend on schedule position by comparing period-3 and period-4 language-switch schedules at matched immediate language recency. Parallel English and German candidate sentences express the same proposition and topic, and a difference-in-differences contrast isolates the effect of schedule position beyond immediate recency. This contrast is positive in all ten pretrained models, ranging from 1.78 1.78 to 4.14 4.14 in candidate-sentence log odds, while a randomly initialized Qwen3-1.7B has the opposite sign (Table 12 ). Continuation probabilities therefore depend on schedule position beyond immediate language recency.

blocks.en: 6 Related Work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en: 6.1 Factorized and structured representations
blocks.zh: 6.1 因数化和结构化的表述

blocks.en: Transformers trained on controlled stochastic processes can represent predictive belief-state geometry ( Shai et al., 2024 ) , and models trained on independent synthetic factors can develop approximately orthogonal factor subspaces ( Shai et al., 2026 ) . Thil et al. (2026) partition JEPA latents into designated progression and content subspaces and evaluate the partition through ablation. These studies examine factors specified by the training process or architecture. We analyze independently evolving contextual variables in fixed pretrained models and characterize their organization through selective accessibility and additive joint-state geometry, including nonorthogonal, information-overlapping subspaces.
blocks.zh: 接受过受控色谱过程训练的变形器可以代表预测性的信仰状态几何(Shai等人,2024年),接受过独立合成因子训练的模型可以发展大约正交因子亚空间(Shai等人,2026年). Thil等人 (2026年) 将 JEPA 潜入指定的进程和内容子空间,并通过衰减来评价分区. 这些研究研究了培训过程或结构所指明的因素。 我们分析固定的预先训练模型中独立演变的背景变量,并通过选择性的可获取性和添加型联合态几何,包括非正统的,信息重叠的子空间来描述其组织特征.

blocks.en: Fel et al. (2026) model activations as sparse additive mixtures of low-dimensional concept manifolds and introduce block-sparse featurizers for discovering this structure without concept labels. Our analyses use experimentally specified variables to measure how their information is distributed across subspaces and how their joint states combine.
blocks.zh: Fel等编. (2026)模型激活作为低维概念多元体的稀疏添加剂混合物,并引入块状散射器,用于发现这种结构而无概念标签. 我们的分析利用实验性指定的变量来衡量其信息如何在子空间之间分布,以及其联合状态如何结合。

blocks.en: 6.2 Temporal state and representational intervention
blocks.zh: 6.2 临时状态和代表干预

blocks.en: Language models encode spatial and temporal coordinates ( Gurnee and Tegmark, 2024 ) , distance to a target length ( Dunefsky et al., 2026 ) , repeated-token count ( Venkatesh, 2026 ) , and contextual entity bindings ( Feng and Steinhardt, 2024 ) . Elapsed wall-clock time can also be supplied through a trained conditioning channel ( Siavoshian et al., 2026 ) . These studies principally address individual temporal quantities or variables introduced and later queried within a context. The present experiments examine two temporal variables that are repeatedly updated in the same hidden states.
blocks.zh: 语言模型编码空间和时间坐标(Gurnee和Tegmark,2024年),距离目标长度(Dunefsky等人,2026年),重复托肯计数(Venkatesh,2026年),以及上下文实体绑定 (冯和施泰因哈特,2024). 也可以通过训练有素的空调通道(Siavoshian等人,2026年)提供埃拉普斯墙钟时间. 这些研究主要针对个别时间数量或引进的变量,后来在某种背景下提出问题。 本实验考察了两个时间变量,它们在同一隐藏状态下反复更新.

blocks.en: Concurrent working-memory variables can exhibit representational overlap ( Xiong et al., 2026 ) and behavioral interference ( Xiong et al., 2026 ; Wang and Sun, 2026 ) . Causal abstraction and interchange-intervention methods evaluate whether representational interventions alter a target while preserving other attributes ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2023 ) ; control tasks calibrate probe capacity ( Hewitt and Liang, 2019 ) . Our analyses distinguish information contained within a timer plane, information remaining after its removal, and output changes under centroid displacement.
blocks.zh: 同时期的工作-记忆变量可以显示出代表重叠(Xiong等人,2026年)和行为干扰(Xiong等人,2026年;Wang and Sun,2026年). causal抽象化和互换干预方法评价代表干预是否在保留其他属性的同时改变目标(Huang等人,2024年;Wu等人,2023年);控制任务校准探测能力(Hewitt和Liang,2019年). 我们的分析区分了计时器平面内的信息,删除后剩余的信息,以及离子体迁移后的产出变化。

blocks.en: 7 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 讨论和结论

blocks.en: The results support an operational notion of approximate factorization based on selective accessibility and approximately additive joint-state geometry ( Park et al., 2024 ; Fel et al., 2026 ) . The timer subspaces are nonorthogonal and information-overlapping, and each contains information about both variables. Nevertheless, removing each timer plane disproportionately impairs decoding of its associated timer, while additive timer contributions explain most joint-centroid variation that generalizes across document splits. Together, restricted decoding, ablation, and joint-state geometry show that factorized organization can coexist with distributed and overlapping representations.
blocks.zh: 结果支持了基于选择性可获取性和大约添加性联态几何的近似要素化操作概念(Park等人,2024年;Fel等人,2026年)。 计时器子空间是非正统的和信息重叠的,每个空间包含两个变量的信息. 尽管如此,去除每个计时器平面会过度损害其相关计时器的解码,而添加剂计时器的贡献则解释了大多数共聚-共聚体变异性,这种变异性在文件的分割中被概括. 限制的解码,减码,和联合态几何等共同显示,因子化的组织可以与分布式和重叠式的表示并存.

blocks.en: This organization persists as the number of timer values increases from 3 to 51 and across Qwen3 checkpoints from 0.6 0.6 B to 14 14 B. Effective centroid rank grows slowly with horizon, while cross-ablation increases but remains substantially weaker than self-ablation. Recency-matched schedule position systematically affects continuation probabilities, and centroid displacements reliably alter decoded timer states, but the tested value-1-to-value-2 intervention produces no consistent timer-specific change in model output. Thus, selective manipulation of decoded state does not necessarily translate into selective downstream control.
blocks.zh: 随着计时器值从3个增加到51个,跨Qwen3检查站的计时器值从0.6 B增加到14 B,该组织继续存在。 有效的中间机器人排名随着地平线增长而缓慢,而交叉计算增加,但仍大大弱于自我计算。 相匹配的排期位置系统地影响延续概率,中间行星迁移可靠地改变解码定时器状态,但经过测试的值-1对值-2的干预在模型输出中并没有产生一致的定时器特定变化. 因此,选择性地操纵解码状态并不一定会转化为选择性的下游控制.

blocks.en: These results motivate further study of when factorized representational structure supports controllable computation. Extending this analysis to richer concurrent variables, more naturalistic contexts, and interventions distributed across layers or multiple tokens may clarify which representational structures contribute to downstream computation. Furthermore, bridging these activation-level timer geometries to underlying counting subcircuits ( Dunefsky et al., 2026 ) and weight-sparse transformer mechanisms ( Gao et al., 2026 ; Marin-Llobet and Heimersheim, 2026 ) could reveal how these states are physically implemented. More broadly, relating factorization to intervention, causal influence, and task-dependent control could help distinguish variables that are accessible in hidden states from those that exert measurable influence on model behavior.
blocks.zh: 这些结果促使人们进一步研究因数化的代表结构何时支持可控计算。 将这一分析扩大到更丰富的同时变量、更自然的背景以及分层或多个标志的干预,可以澄清哪些代表结构有助于下游计算。 此外,将这些激活电位计时器与地下计数子电路(Dunefsky等人,2026年)和重压变压器机制(Gao等人,2026年;Marin-Llobet和Heimersheim,2026年)连接起来,可以揭示这些状态是如何实际实施的。 更广泛地说,将要素化与干预、因果影响和任务依赖性控制联系起来,可有助于区分隐藏状态下可获取的变量和对模式行为产生可衡量影响的变量。
